name: Tweet Inline
author: Romain Boulay
description: Replaces empty/lazy Twitter (X) blockquotes and bare tweet links in articles with the inlined tweet content: author, text, and media. Fetches from Twitter's public first-party syndication endpoint (no API key or login required), with an automatic fxtwitter fallback. Designed for feeds like lephoceen.fr 'En direct des RS'.
